source: OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0) via Geofabrik guangdong-latest.osm.pbf; processed by scripts/build_city_data.py

route.legsNote: one named road per leg, travelling `bearing` (deg) on the matching one-way carriageway; consecutive legs are joined by a tangent circular fillet of `radius` m at their crossing (`turn` = expected direction). 益田路 and 金田路 cross 深南大道 on overpasses in reality; simplified to at-grade junctions. The 福田 CBD loop passes the foot of 平安金融中心 (益田路 southbound, tower dead ahead) and ends on 福中三路 directly in front of the Civic Center's south facade.

legs.name: 福中三路
legs.offsetNote: the real westbound carriageway (~2 lanes) runs 2-35 m from the Civic Center's south facade; our 4-lane carriageway is shifted 7 m south (into the Civic Square side) so its right edge sits on the real carriageway centre line

route.finishNote: finish abeam the finish landmark's centroid on the last leg (middle of the Civic Center's south facade) + finishOffset m

cutsNote: none: the full real route is driven. Until v0.3.2 two straights were cut (800-2600 科技园 east incl. 科苑北路/铜鼓路 and an OSM lane-shift jog near 铜鼓路; 7500-9500 竹子林 - 车公庙 west), 76% of the real length
sideRoadsNote: 辅路 from OSM (ways named *辅路 / *辅道, or unnamed secondary / tertiary / unclassified ways) running parallel to the route, minGap-maxGap m beyond the carriageway's outer edge (one-way ones in the direction of the adjacent carriageway); holes up to fillGap m bridged, runs shorter than minRun m dropped, smoothed with smoothSigma m; the planted separator (侧分带) keeps at least minSeparator m. Scenery only: the drivable carriageway and its walls do not change. route.json sideRoadRight / sideRoadLeft = centre offset d per centerline sample (null = none), sideRoadLanes = runs with the OSM lanes tag (defaultLanes if missing). buildingSetback = keep-out for buildings beyond the side road's asphalt edge (curb + sidewalk).
streetFurnitureNote: footbridges (highway=footway/path/steps/... with bridge=*) crossing the route at more than 45 deg, bus stops (highway=bus_stop / public_transport=platform) and subway entrances (railway=subway_entrance) beside it, in route coordinates; scenery only.

race.note: optimal-lap estimator (SU7 Ultra): v <= sqrt(latAcc * R); a(v) = accel * (1 - (v / vmax)^2); constant braking; target ~2:45-3:15

viewCorridorsNote: off since v0.5.0 (real heights win; landmarks may be hidden by real buildings and trees). When set: buildings crossing a sight line from the chase camera to a landmark are capped just below the line (dropped if the cap is < minKeep m or they are procedural fillers); s0/s1 are final route s or turnStart/turnEnd/finish; halfFov = bearing limit from the route tangent; swept wedges -> route.json clearZones. v0.4.3 used: pingan {s0: {at: landmark:eiffel, offset: 300}, s1: turn1Start, step 10, minVisibleFrom 220, halfFov 45}; pingan {s0: turn1End, s1: landmark:pingan, step 5, minVisibleFrom 30, halfFov 60}; civic_center {s0: {at: 深南大道, offset: -200}, s1: finish, step 5, minVisibleFrom 8, halfFov 100, targetSpacing 20}; eiffel {s0: {at: landmark:eiffel, offset: -890}, s1: landmark:eiffel, step 10, minVisibleFrom 40, halfFov 75, targetSpacing 10}

viewCorridorDefaults.keepNote: never capped: 华侨城大厦 / OCT Tower (300 m, signature of the OCT section; hides the distant Ping An tip only around s 3000-3450)

cmabNote: CMAB China Multi-Attribute Building dataset (Zhang, Zhao, Long; Mendeley Data b4t2wxhn2y v5, CC BY 4.0): machine-learned rooftop height / function / age. An OSM footprint matches the rooftop with the largest overlap when the overlap exceeds minOverlap of the footprint or the rooftop centroid lies inside it. Height priority: OSM height > OSM levels > CMAB > zone estimate; preferOverLevels = [lo, hi) bands of the levels height where CMAB wins instead (from the calibration printed by the pipeline: none, levels are closer in every band). skipArea = footprint area range (m2) where CMAB is not used: on 1500-3000 m2 footprints (towers) CMAB underestimates by a median 64 m and is no better than the zone estimate; on all other sizes it beats the estimate (median error 5-23 m vs 10-46 m on 370 buildings with OSM height or levels). The CMAB origin release covers Shenzhen only east of lon 114.028 (福田 / 罗湖, file zhusanjiaoyi20220302); 南山 is not in it.
overtureNote: Overture Maps buildings (ODbL 1.0; release in data-raw/overture/buildings.parquet.state). Only features whose sources are not OpenStreetMap (machine-learned rooftops) are used, and only where they overlap no OSM building by maxOsmOverlap of their own area and lie outside open space (maxOpenOverlap or centroid inside). Same road-corridor, minArea and far rules as OSM buildings; ids 1e15 + hash of the Overture id, src = overture.

procedural.note: off since v0.5.0: with Overture footprints added, the land these blocks filled shows no building in either OSM or Overture (parks, depots, construction sites, interchanges). When enabled: filler blocks (negative ids, counted as 'estimated') only where OSM / Overture have no building, road, park/water/plaza/parking or landmark

heights.zonesNote: for other types: [maxFootprintArea m2, [minH, maxH]] by zone; value = min + (max-min) * u^1.3, u = hash(osm id)

cityModelsNote: real-building models from 3D Warehouse (General Model License; credits in docs/asset-credits.md). scripts/process_city_models.mjs bakes each raw GLB (data-raw/assets/3dwarehouse, never shipped) into public/models/city/<id>.glb + index.json; build_city_data.py registers them against OSM footprints (yaw + translation maximising IoU), applies the cut transform and writes public/data/city_models.json. role: landmark (atlas <= 1024) / frontage / skyline (<= 512). landmark = hand-built landmark (src/city/landmarks) this model corresponds to; replaceLandmark hides that landmark at runtime. osm = force the registration target(s); yaw = deg added after the search (three.js rotation.y sense); register=false keeps the manifest position and native orientation. process: per-model overrides for the GLB baker (groundY in native metres, keepBox/dropBox [x0, z0, x1, z1] native, atlas px, photo).
